name: Collection workbench
description: One saved view, live as a table, cards and a selectable list.

handlers.description: Draw this view's question as table, cards and list; the note's query, group, sort and columns are the controls

components.title: Collection workbench
components.intro: One saved view is the source. A workbench:: line draws its current matches as a table, cards and an openable list. Change [query::], [group::], [sort::], [direction::] or [columns::] in the same note and all three redraw; any property name may be a group, sort or column. The answer, row ids, facets and completeness are in the component's data for an agent or inspector.
components.where: a view note with a workbench:: line

props.meaning: Draws the live answer of this note's saved query
The saved view's membership question; property names are open
A property or date bucket to group on; defaults to type
A property, title, created or updated; defaults to updated
Comma-separated property names for the table; defaults to the answer's most common fields
